readme: FROZEN baseline for the echo-tier downgrade test. Walmart is recorded here as echo=true (its title really did read 'milk - Walmart.com' on 2026-08-02). Paired with searchlinks-paramrot/responses.json, where Walmart answers 200 with a generic title instead, it proves the DOWNGRADE branch can still fire: that is the 200-but-ignores-our-query rot, which no status code and no not-found check would ever catch.
